subject: CCTX
title: Taxation 1
description: Basic principles of tax law; residence, meaning and computation of taxable income; computation of personal tax; foreign tax credits; capital gains; partnerships; trusts; administration and enforcement; case decisions; Revenue Department bulletins, circulars and rulings; appeals.

prerequisites.text: Prerequisite: (CACC 521 or CACC 621) or (CACC 520 or CACC 620)

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken CCTX 511.

subject: CCTX
title: Taxation 2
description: Theoretical analysis of federal corporate taxation. Current issues in taxation will also be discussed and analyzed.

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken CCTX 532.
